name: Seido Gakuensai ~Nikuyoku ni Oboreru Onna Kyoushi-tachi~
original_name: 性奴学艶祭 ～肉欲に溺れる女教師達～
source: Akihiko is the president of the student council and every teacher and student trusts him. The school festival is two months away but there is a secret plan, to insult female teachers on the festival day. The goal is to insult and train beautiful teachers before that day and expose them on the main stage on the festival day, and deteriorate the school's reputation. Akihiko's insulting plan starts now...
